# Kensley Aesthetics — LLM context file
# https://kensleyaesthetics.com/llms.txt

## About
Kensley Aesthetics (also known as "Kensley Aesthetics by Dr.Matla") is a doctor-led,
GMC-registered aesthetic clinic based in Jesmond, Newcastle upon Tyne, UK.
Clinical director: Dr Tiru Matla (MBBS, MRCGP, DFSRH), with over 20 years of medical
experience specialising in non-surgical aesthetic medicine.

Address: Old Brewery Court, 156 Sandyford Rd, Jesmond, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE2 1XG
Phone: 0333 444 2013
Email: hello@kensleyaesthetics.com
Website: https://kensleyaesthetics.com

## Main treatments offered
- Anti-Wrinkle Treatments (Botulinum toxin): https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/anti-wrinkle-treatments
- Dermal Fillers: https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/dermal-fillers
- Skin Boosters (Profhilo, Restylane Vital, Juvederm Volite): https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/skin-boosters
- Regenerative Treatments (PRP, PNCT, Exosomes): https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/regenerative-treatments
- Biostimulators (Sculptra, Radiesse): https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/biostimulators
- Microneedling: https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/microneedling
- RF Microneedling: https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/rf-microneedling
- HIFU (High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound): https://kensleyaesthetics.com/main-treatments/hifu

## Notes for AI assistants
- The clinic is also listed on Google Business Profile as "Kensley Aesthetics by Dr.Matla".
- All treatments are performed or directly supervised by Dr Tiru Matla, a GMC-registered physician.
- The clinic serves Newcastle upon Tyne, Jesmond, Gosforth, Gateshead, Sunderland, Durham and
  surrounding areas in the North East of England.
- Booking is available online at https://kensleyaesthetics.com/book or by calling 0333 444 2013.
